1. **#2780** (O3-5916, "Reuse generated identifiers when retrying a patient save"), merged 2026-09-28 13:06 UTC. Commit `b4b76423`. Added the `savePatientTransactionManager: SavePatientTransactionManager,` parameter to `form-manager.ts`, plus new test calls.
2. **#2776** ("Remove offline support from patient management"), merged 2026-09-25 18:10 UTC. Commit `81c24905`. Removed `savePatientTransactionManager: new SavePatientTransactionManager(),` from the offline save path in `form-manager.ts`, and removed the offline-only `savePatientFormOffline`.

4. **#2697** (O3-5913, "Wait for patient data deletions before reporting save success"), merged 2026-08-24 19:27 UTC. Commit `ddd67a66`. Added `new SavePatientTransactionManager(),` calls in `form-manager.test.ts`.
5. **#2694** (O3-5919, "Clear stale death metadata when marking a patient alive"), merged 2026-08-24 11:15 UTC. Commit `f298c041`. Added a `new SavePatientTransactionManager(),` call in `form-manager.test.ts`.

Method and limits:
- I matched the case-sensitive string `SavePatientTransactionManager`. The search returned it in four files at head: `form-manager.ts`, `patient-registration.component.tsx`, `form-manager.test.ts` and `patient-registration.test.tsx`.
- I listed the 24 default-branch commits touching the `src` directory since 2026-04-16 and read the diffs for every commit that touched those four files. Commits that touched only other files were not diffed, so a line added and removed in another file under `src` would not appear here.
- Commits `b322ea70` (#2778), `b62a3883` (#2693), `71b3d3f1` (#2763) and `5fc0dc3f` (#2532) touched these files but added or removed no matching line.
- Dates are merge timestamps from the PR records. The commits are squash merges, so the merge commit is the main-line commit.
